day1_intro.speaker: Officer Dave
day1_intro.text: Afternoon mate. How's it going, mate?

friendly.speaker: Officer Dave
friendly.text: Sweet as mate, just doing the rounds. Keep up the good work, mate.

suspicious.speaker: Officer Dave
suspicious.text: Just checking in, mate. Everything all goods here, mate?

day2_intro.speaker: Officer Dave
day2_intro.text: G'day mate. Saw that young fella hanging around earlier, mate. Listen mate, I don't usually stick my nose in, but word is the Gumboot Gang's getting a bit keen, mate.

choices.text: Can you guys help out, mate?

acknowledge.speaker: Officer Dave
acknowledge.text: Chur mate, just keep your eyes open, ay? Cheers mate.

request_help.speaker: Officer Dave
request_help.text: We'll keep an eye out mate, but we can't watch your shop 24/7, mate. Just give us a hoy if anything looks dodgy, alright mate?

day3_intro.speaker: Officer Dave
day3_intro.text: How's it going mate? Seen anything sus lately, mate?

choices.text: What's the deal with this gang, mate?

nothing.speaker: Officer Dave
nothing.text: Sweet as mate, stay sharp though, ay mate?

ask_about_gang.speaker: Officer Dave
ask_about_gang.text: Ah the Gumboot boys, mate? Bit of a nuisance mostly, but getting a bit too cheeky lately, mate. Let us know if you spot anything, mate.

day4_intro.speaker: Officer Dave
day4_intro.text: G'day mate. Everything quiet on your end, mate?

quiet.speaker: Officer Dave
quiet.text: Good to hear mate, we'll keep patrolling the area, mate.

share_info.speaker: Officer Dave
share_info.text: What's up mate? You heard something, mate?

choices.text: Heard about possible ram raids, mate

raid_info.speaker: Officer Dave
raid_info.text: Ram raids? That's proper serious, mate. We'll bump up the patrols, mate. Good on ya for speaking up, mate.

day5_intro.speaker: Officer Dave
day5_intro.text: Listen mate, we need some info on the Gumboot Gang, mate. Hearing they're planning something big, mate. You seen that young fella lately, mate? We need to have a chat with him, mate.

not_seen.speaker: Officer Dave
not_seen.text: No worries mate, give us a bell if you spot him, ay mate?

arrest_question.speaker: Officer Dave
arrest_question.text: If he's mixed up in this gang business, yeah mate. So you seen him around, mate?

choices.text: Yeah he just took off mate

inform.speaker: Officer Dave
inform.text: Choice mate, good on ya. We'll track him down, mate.

day6_intro.speaker: Officer Dave
day6_intro.text: Cheers for your help yesterday mate, we got some good intel off that, mate.

choices.text: What happened to the kid, mate?

kid_fate.speaker: Officer Dave
kid_fate.text: Had to arrest the young fella, mate. Mixed up in conspiracy charges, mate. The Gumboot boys were gonna ram raid your dairy tonight, mate. Luckily we got most of them, but the big boss is still out there, mate. We'll keep you posted, mate.

day7_check_ending.speaker: Officer Dave
day7_check_ending.text: Right mate, final day. We've been watching your shop all week...

ending_branch.speaker: Officer Dave
ending_branch.text: We know everything. The hoons, the fake IDs, all of it. You've been running a proper shady operation here, mate.

choices.text: I was helping you the whole time!

busted_ending.speaker: Officer Dave
busted_ending.text: Explain it to the judge, mate. You're under arrest for dealing illegal goods. Should have kept your nose clean, mate.

defiant_ending.speaker: Officer Dave
defiant_ending.text: We've got CCTV, witness statements, the lot. Trying to be a tough guy just makes it worse for you, mate. Cuffs on, now.

cooperation_ending.speaker: Officer Dave
cooperation_ending.text: Helping us? You were making money off their operation, mate. That makes you part of the gang in our books. Time to come with us.

clean_ending.speaker: Officer Dave
clean_ending.text: You kept your nose clean mate, that's what we like to see. Thanks for your help with the investigation. Stay safe out there, mate.
